fields.label: Microeconomics
fields.description: Household, firm and market behaviour: labour, public economics and taxation, industrial organisation, education, health, crime, development economics using household, firm or village data, applied microeconometrics, microeconomic theory
positive_criteria: Unit of analysis is individuals, households, firms or single markets
Policy evaluation with micro data (e.g. tax, welfare, schooling, labour market programmes)
Sub-national units (states, provinces, cities) when the topic is public services, crime, health, education or labour policy
exclusions: Aggregate economy, growth, business cycles, monetary or fiscal aggregates → Macroeconomics
Asset pricing, corporate finance, banking → Finance
Experimental or behavioural decision-making studies → Behavioural/Experimental Economics
Firm-level management or strategy → Business Administration
Cross-country growth and development regressions → Macroeconomics

fields.label: Macroeconomics
fields.description: Aggregate economy: growth, business cycles, monetary and fiscal policy, inflation, unemployment at the aggregate level, international trade and finance, financial crises and macro-financial stability, macroeconometrics and forecasting
positive_criteria: Unit of analysis is countries, regions or the aggregate economy
Uses macro time series, panels of countries or DSGE-style models
Sub-national units when the topic is growth, inflation or aggregate output
exclusions: Individual or firm-level micro data as the main evidence → Microeconomics
Asset pricing and financial markets → Finance

fields.label: Behavioural/Experimental Economics
fields.description: Economic decision-making studied with behavioural theory and usually experimental methods (lab, field or online experiments). Must have explicit economic framing: utility, incentives, markets, auctions, game theory, social preferences
positive_criteria: Published in a behavioural or experimental economics venue (e.g. Experimental Economics, Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Games and Economic Behavior)
Incentivised experiment or behavioural model in a general economics journal
exclusions: General judgement and decision-making without economic framing → Psychology (Cognitive)
Consumer behaviour without economic theory → Marketing
Behavioural or experimental work in marketing, accounting, finance or labour journals → that journal's field

fields.label: Finance
fields.description: Asset pricing, financial markets, corporate finance, banking, investor behaviour, household finance in developed credit and asset markets
positive_criteria: Outcomes are prices, returns, capital structure, credit or investment decisions
exclusions: Monetary policy and macro-financial aggregates → Macroeconomics
Accounting and management control → Business Administration
Financial crises, systemic risk and credit aggregates studied at the country level → Macroeconomics
Microcredit and financial access as a development intervention → Microeconomics

fields.label: Business Administration
fields.description: Management, strategy, operations, supply chain, accounting, entrepreneurship, innovation, human resource management
exclusions: Marketing and consumer research → Marketing
Corporate finance and financial markets → Finance
Organisational behaviour theory in psychology venues → Psychology
positive_criteria: Unit of analysis is the firm or manager; outcomes are strategy, performance, innovation, accounting or HR practice

fields.label: Marketing
fields.description: Marketing strategy, consumer behaviour, branding, advertising, market research, sales, pricing
exclusions: Social-psychological theory in psychology venues → Social Psychology

fields.label: Business Informatics
fields.description: Information systems, enterprise systems, digital transformation, IT management
exclusions: Pure computer science → Computer Science
Business AI without information-systems focus → Computer Science/Business Admin
